description: Body-pose binder parallel to bind_audio_reactive: take the 33-sample MediaPipe pose CHOP produced by setup_body_tracking and derive scalar reactive channels (right-hand height, arms openness, elbow angle, hand velocity, …) on a Null CHOP ready for bind_to_channel. Each channel is a Select→Math→Hold→Filter→Limit→Rename chain inside a fresh baseCOMP, all merged into one null_out. Supported metrics: y/x/z (1 landmark), distance/openness (2 landmarks), angle (3 — vertex middle), velocity (1, time-derivative). Optional `bindings[]` writes expression-mode binds directly onto target parameters (same shape as bind_to_channel; failures collected as warnings, not throws). Exposes a Reactive custom page with Smoothing/Intensity/Bypass/Gate_<name> knobs. Heads-up: MediaPipe's `landmarks` are 2D (z near-zero) — z/distance/angle/velocity are unreliable unless the adapter exposes `worldLandmarks`; the tool emits a warning when it detects a constant tz. Run setup_body_tracking first.

bindings.description: Optional list of parameter paths to bind to the derived channels (expression-mode bind, like bind_audio_reactive).

param.description: Target parameter, dotted path: '/project1/myComp:Speed' — same shape as bind_to_channel.

channels.description: Reactive channels to derive. Landmark IDs cheat-sheet — 0 nose, 11 L-shoulder, 12 R-shoulder, 13 L-elbow, 14 R-elbow, 15 L-wrist, 16 R-wrist, 23 L-hip, 24 R-hip, 25 L-knee, 26 R-knee, 27 L-ankle, 28 R-ankle.

clamp.description: Final clamp range [min,max]; set both null to skip clamping.

confidence_gate.description: If landmark confidence < gate, hold the last value (Hold CHOP).

landmarks.description: MediaPipe pose landmark IDs (0..32). Counts by metric: y/x/z/velocity=1, distance/openness=2, angle=3 (vertex middle).

metric.description: How to derive a scalar from the landmarks: y/x/z (1 landmark), distance (2), angle (3, vertex middle), velocity (1, time-derivative of position), openness (2, shoulder-pair distance).

name.description: Output channel name on the Null CHOP, e.g. 'right_hand_y'. Must be unique.

expose_controls.description: Append Smoothing/Intensity/Bypass/Gate_<name> knobs to the container.

source_chop.description: Path to the 33-sample MediaPipe pose CHOP (tx/ty/tz/confidence channels) — typically the Null produced by setup_body_tracking.

name: create_pose_reactive
title: Make a network react to body pose
